verdict.rationale: Context.dev is an API-first product. Its documented public API spans scrape, crawl, extract, map, screenshot, brand, people, news and batch endpoints, with API-key management, rate-limit headers, timeout semantics, an agent auth flow, and TypeScript and Python SDKs. A probe independently confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at docs.context.dev/openapi.json and an llms.txt index. A community user also reports having the API in production within an hour of signing up.
